numbering.sequences.title: Document numbering
numbering.sequences.search: Search document type, company, prefix or number (/)
numbering.sequence.paddingHint: How many digits the counter shows, with leading zeros (1 to {max}).
numbering.sequence.needsEveryBranch: Every branch of this company numbers its documents with this sequence. Only someone who works in every branch of the company may change it.
numbering.sequence.gaplessLabel: Never skip a number (gapless: a document waits while another of the same sequence is being saved)
numbering.sequence.perBranchLabel: Each branch counts on its own (use {BRANCH} in the prefix or suffix)
numbering.sequence.nextNumberHint: Leave empty to keep counting on. Never below a number already given.
numbering.sequence.nextNumberPerBranch: Each branch keeps its own next number.
numbering.preview.title: Next numbers
numbering.preview.invalid: Correct the pattern to see the next numbers.
numbering.preview.mayskip: A document that is not saved leaves its number unused.
numbering.counter.title: Counters
numbering.counter.none: No number has been given yet.
numbering.recent.title: Last numbers given
numbering.validation.maxLength: {0, plural, one {Use at most # character.} other {Use at most # characters.}}
numbering.validation.numberingReset: Choose when the numbers start again: never, every year or every month.
numbering.validation.numberingYearlyNeed: Numbers that start again every year need the year in the prefix or suffix ({YYYY} or {YY}), or this year's numbers would repeat last year's.
numbering.validation.numberingMonthlyNee: Numbers that start again every month need the year and the month in the prefix or suffix ({YYYY} or {YY}, and {MM}).
numbering.validation.numberingPerBranchN: Numbers counted per branch need {BRANCH} in the prefix or suffix, or two branches would give the same number.
numbering.validation.numberingBranchNeed: {BRANCH} shows the branch's code: count the numbers per branch to use it.
numbering.validation.numberingToken: Use only the tokens {YYYY}, {YY}, {MM} and {BRANCH} between braces.
numbering.validation.numberingCharacters: Use letters A to Z, digits and the separators - / . _ # only.
numbering.validation.numberingNextNumber: Enter a whole number from 1 to {0}.
